item.text:
I pushed the design further by removing the remaining `Object`/runtime-type checks from the simulation core.

[Field.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Field.java:14) now stores `Animal[][]` and `Plant[][]` explicitly and exposes typed APIs like `getAnimalAt`/`placeAnimal`, which let [Animal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Animal.java:116) and the view/stats code stop casting from `Object`. I also tightened the disease-block scan there so block bounds are derived from a named constant instead of raw `20`s.

I also moved diet and mating logic fully onto species metadata instead of class comparisons. [HerbivoreAnimal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/HerbivoreAnimal.java:40) and [CarnivoreAnimal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/CarnivoreAnimal.java:46) now work with `Set<PlantSpecies>` and `Set<AnimalSpecies>`, and concrete animals like [Sheep.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Sheep.java:22) and [CarnivoreFox.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/CarnivoreFox.java:22) declare their diets as enum sets. That keeps species behavior aligned with the earlier species enums instead of duplicating class lists across the model.

I also cleaned up a couple of dependent callers: [PopulationGenerator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/PopulationGenerator.java:98) no longer does a redundant `instanceof` check during initial infection seeding, and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/SimulatorView.java:205) now reads typed animal occupancy directly.

Verification: the refactored core simulation classes compile successfully with the same temporary UI stubs as before. Full project compilation is still blocked here by the existing JavaFX dependency in `Dashboard.java`.
